with source as (

    select * from "observatorio"."raw"."anp_precos"

),

typed as (

    select
        regexp_replace(cnpj_revenda, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')                      as cnpj_revenda,
        upper(trim(produto))                                                 as produto,
        try_strptime(trim(data_coleta), '%d/%m/%Y')::date                    as data_coleta,
        try_cast(replace(trim(valor_venda), ',', '.') as decimal(10, 4))     as valor_venda,
        case
            when trim(unidade_medida) = 'R$ / litro' then 'R$/litro'
            when trim(unidade_medida) in ('R$ / m³', 'R$ / m3') then 'R$/m3'
            else trim(unidade_medida)
        end                                                                  as unidade_medida,
        case
            when upper(trim(bandeira)) = 'VIBRA ENERGIA' then 'VIBRA'
            else upper(trim(bandeira))
        end                                                                  as bandeira,
        trim(revenda)                                                        as revenda,
        upper(trim(regiao_sigla))                                            as regiao_sigla,
        upper(trim(estado_sigla))                                            as uf,
        upper(trim(municipio))                                               as municipio,
        trim(bairro)                                                         as bairro,
        trim(cep)                                                            as cep,
        _source_group                                                        as source_group,
        case _source_group
            when 'mensal' then 1
            when 'semestral' then 2
            when 'ultimas_4_semanas' then 3
            else 9
        end                                                                  as source_priority
    from source

),

ranked as (

    select
        *,
        min(source_priority) over (
            partition by cnpj_revenda, produto, data_coleta
        ) as best_priority
    from typed

),

best as (

    select * from ranked where source_priority = best_priority

)

select
    cnpj_revenda,
    produto,
    data_coleta,
    round(avg(valor_venda), 4)::decimal(10, 4)  as valor_venda,
    min(unidade_medida)                         as unidade_medida,
    min(bandeira)                               as bandeira,
    min(revenda)                                as revenda,
    min(regiao_sigla)                           as regiao_sigla,
    min(uf)                                     as uf,
    min(municipio)                              as municipio,
    min(bairro)                                 as bairro,
    min(cep)                                    as cep,
    min(source_group)                           as source_group,
    count(*)                                    as n_registros_origem
from best
group by cnpj_revenda, produto, data_coleta

with price as (

    select
        d.mes_referencia,
        p.produto,
        l.uf,
        avg(f.valor_venda)                  as preco_medio,
        count(*)                            as n_observacoes,
        count(distinct f.cnpj_revenda)      as n_revendas,
        count(distinct f.data_coleta)       as n_dias_coleta
    from "observatorio"."marts"."fact_preco_combustivel" as f
    inner join "observatorio"."marts"."dim_produto"    as p on f.produto_key = p.produto_key
    inner join "observatorio"."marts"."dim_localidade" as l on f.localidade_key = l.localidade_key
    inner join "observatorio"."marts"."dim_data"       as d on f.data_key = d.data_key
    group by 1, 2, 3

),

ipca as (

    select
        mes_referencia,
        max(valor) filter (where variavel_codigo = 63)   as ipca_mensal_pct,
        max(valor) filter (where variavel_codigo = 69)   as ipca_acum_ano_pct,
        max(valor) filter (where variavel_codigo = 2265) as ipca_12m_pct
    from "observatorio"."staging"."stg_ibge_ipca"
    group by 1

),

sgs as (

    select
        date_trunc('month', data)::date                           as mes_referencia,
        avg(valor) filter (where serie_codigo = 432)              as selic_meta_aa_media,
        avg(valor) filter (where serie_codigo = 1)                as usd_brl_venda_medio
    from "observatorio"."staging"."stg_bcb_sgs"
    group by 1

)

select
    pr.mes_referencia,
    pr.produto,
    pr.uf,
    round(pr.preco_medio, 4)                                                        as preco_medio,
    pr.n_observacoes,
    pr.n_revendas,
    pr.n_dias_coleta,
    round((pr.preco_medio / prev_m.preco_medio - 1) * 100, 4)                       as variacao_preco_mom_pct,
    round((pr.preco_medio / prev_y.preco_medio - 1) * 100, 4)                       as variacao_preco_12m_pct,
    ipca.ipca_mensal_pct,
    ipca.ipca_acum_ano_pct,
    ipca.ipca_12m_pct,
    round(sgs.selic_meta_aa_media, 4)                                               as selic_meta_aa_media,
    round(sgs.usd_brl_venda_medio, 4)                                               as usd_brl_venda_medio
from price as pr
left join price as prev_m
    on  prev_m.produto = pr.produto
    and prev_m.uf = pr.uf
    and prev_m.mes_referencia = (pr.mes_referencia - interval 1 month)::date
left join price as prev_y
    on  prev_y.produto = pr.produto
    and prev_y.uf = pr.uf
    and prev_y.mes_referencia = (pr.mes_referencia - interval 12 month)::date
left join ipca on ipca.mes_referencia = pr.mes_referencia
left join sgs  on sgs.mes_referencia  = pr.mes_referencia

-- The mart must not lose or invent observations: totals must match the fact table.
select m.total as mart_rows, f.total as fact_rows
from (select sum(n_observacoes) as total from "observatorio"."marts"."mart_preco_inflacao_mensal") as m
cross join (select count(*) as total from "observatorio"."marts"."fact_preco_combustivel") as f
where m.total <> f.total
